prompt: No model and no prompt: made in code from the winner candidates/a/fx/black-hole.png. Eight frames: the three-armed vortex turns clockwise, 45 degrees further in each frame (one full turn over the sheet, so frame 8 runs on into frame 1); the dark core and its lilac rim stay fixed in the centre while the arms and the crackle turn.
origin: derived in code from the owner's winner: no AI model, no GPU, no server
label: Black-hole spin sheet, 8 frames, on the black key

transform.layout: 2 rows x 4, read left to right then the bottom row
transform.gutters: none drawn; one continuous black canvas
transform.background: exact black 0,0,0 like the winner (pixels whose max channel is <= 4 after scaling are set to 0)
transform.spin: clockwise about the dark core's centre (y 510.65, x 508.20 in the winner), frame k at (k-1) x 45 degrees = 360/8; the three arms are different colours (violet, indigo, steel blue), so only a full turn loops: a 120/8 = 15 degree step would swap the arm colours at frame 8 -> 1
transform.core: the disc r <= 123 px of the winner (dark core r ~96, lilac rim peak r 110) is not rotated: identical in every frame; the crackle and the arms outside it turn
transform.resampling: bilinear rotation at the winner's resolution onto a 1053 px canvas, area-averaged (Pillow BOX) to the cell, scale 0.3419

comments.comment: there seems to be no difference in images they should each visually be different showing progression of a spinning spiral
